_comment: Rig mapping from compare_ker_follower.py dry runs. Unmodified KER driving OpenArm 1.0 followers (software wrist remap). Joint 7 is inverted on both sides. j6_limit_deg 44 because this rig's follower J6 limit is +-45 (helpers/rollout.yaml).

park._comment: Follower joint space, deg. Rest defaults to the calibration pose (all 0, grippers closed). Only joints 1 and 4 move; forward shoulder pitch is negative J1 on the left arm and positive on the right. 1) Tuck: upper arms back 75 deg while the elbows fold to 135, so the grippers rise straight up beside the body. 2) Swing the upper arms forward to 25 deg with the elbows still folded, carrying the grippers over the table edge high. 3) Open the elbows to 90 = the ready pose. blend rounds the two corners so the move does not stop at them.
